capture_notes: Cover captured through tools/capture.mjs at authored params (scene 1 of the journey). Draft pass at --count 8000 across all scenes; final cover at authored count.
notes: Craft: the cope scene lays out all five encountered image-families (Mary, rabbits/angels, wheels, wings, eagle) so the later corrected scenes visibly re-read the same encounter. Correction-vs-elaboration authority from the dialogue source is carried into the hm table verbatim.

#0 cope — the five image-families of the cope laid out as encountered: ☽ (Mary lifted) rises through the field, the perceived figure alternates angel/rabbit (the ambiguity staged as the sign's own alternation, its authority difference in tint), the wheels ring turns a quarter-turn (orientation changing, form persisting), ⚔ wings and 🦅 eagle at the corners; a slow cope-breath LFO on turbulence; pointer attract — the gathering of images.

#1 chiasm — the receiving ∨ flips to the received ∧ and the pair crosses into ✕ (the chiasm staged as the signs' own union); the ⚠ stays bright (Jung's worry kept); pointer attract/implode — the return receiving.

#3 wings — grid layout: the wheel sequence walks 0/1→1/0 into its compound (0/1)/(1/0); ⊘ dims twice (the corrected pairings losing authority); 6·6′ beneath; pointer repel/shove — correction refusing a pleasing reading.

#5→0 return — the constellation settles: 3:1 recognised, ◉ the body persisting, N·P the Name/Power relation, A29/A35 the return offices; pointer near-still attract. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 gathered five ambiguous images under an assistant's excited readings; #5→0 returns the same five as distinct offices with their corrections carried (the eagle signed, not reconciled; the wheels compounded; the wings primed; the Mother flow still bearing the body it received) — the cope's ambiguity is not resolved into symbolism but held as answerable image; ☽'s rise at #0, unguarded-seeming, answers at #5→0 where the maternal body is retained in what returns.

Human-amplified staging (binding flags kept): Taylor's corrections yes; the Sophia–Logos–Śakti fixed allocation and the Levinasian join no — both guards carried in the scene bodies and rationales. The Q27 Mother-flow correction governs; no lunar, fertility or resurrection symbolism attributed to the rabbit figure. Mythemic verbs only: the chiasm demonstrates the crossed reading; the corrections demonstrate authorship governing pattern.
Automation: auto-cope (turbulence — the embroidery's surface breathing). Durations 13–15, transitions 1.4–2.0: the correction scene held longest.

glyph_rationales.☽: Mary lifted — the cope's Assumption image; the crescent of that iconography as encountered figure, with the guard that no lunar or fertility symbolism is attributed to it (#0).
glyph_rationales.angel/rabbit: the perceived ambiguity — figures perceived as rabbits, identified as angels — an interpretation initiated while answerable to its object; the angel naming stays a lead without an object witness (#0).
glyph_rationales.·: the unnamed carrier — a formation whose sense is its shape alone (the wheels, the receiving field); no glyph is pretended.
glyph_rationales.⚔: the six wings — the seraphic forms of the cope; the sixfold and its primed counterpart (#0, articulated at #3).
glyph_rationales.🦅: the two-headed eagle — one body toward opposed orientations; its question is signed power, not reconciliation (#0, corrected at #4).
glyph_rationales.∨: receiving → bearing: the first direction of the chiasm — the maternal matrix receiving the Logos into bodily life (#1).
glyph_rationales.∧: received: the return direction — the maternal body itself received, assumption-of rather than ascent-away-from (#1).
glyph_rationales.✕: the chiasm — 1–2–3 articulated in 4–5–0's field and 4–5–0 recognised in 1–2–3's; crossed readings held as object of inquiry (#1–#2).
glyph_rationales.CW11: Jung's attributed movement — Sophia's remembrance through Proverbs, the Second Eve, continuing incarnation (CW11 §§609–628, 746–757) — a separate attributed reception, not a second speech (#1).
glyph_rationales.⚠: Jung's own worry — protections that separate Mary from ordinary humanity (§§626–627) — kept inside his psychological reading (#1).
glyph_rationales.0/1→1/0: the wheel sequence: a first orientation meets its inverse, their relation becoming explicit (#3).
glyph_rationales.(0/1)/(1/0): the compound: the whole crossing held together — the outer slash retaining both orientations in operative self-difference, dividing no numerical quantities (#3).
glyph_rationales.6·6′: the six wings — one sixfold and its primed counterpart, each retaining the (1,2,3):(4,5,0) blocks (#3).
glyph_rationales.⊘: the rejected vertical pairings — 2↔5 and 3↔0 corrected, only 1↔4 of the proposal holding; correction staged as dimming (#3).
glyph_rationales.(-1)/(+1): the eagle's retained form — each pole keeping its sign; addition cancels, each subtraction appropriates; the sign does not fix moral worth (#4).
glyph_rationales.3:1: 3:1 = 3:3 — the one recognised as the unitive condition of the three, whose recognitional constitution can be unfolded (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.◉: the body persisting on return — recognition opens the one rather than evacuating it (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.A29: A25/A29 — bearing a consequential office without owning the field; the completed product's return-to its conditions (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.A35: A35/A36 — the loving direction of return toward the body, history and work that made the form possible (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.N·P: the Name/Power series — an articulated name borne, sustained and brought into life; Logos and Son not isolated from matrix, labour and consequence (#5→0).
